hyperedges.label: All adapter packages (dom, ng, vue) wrap core TableStore
All test apps verify packages via Verdaccio (not workspace symlinks)
All test apps use dogapi.dog as their live backend

nodes.label: TableStore<T>
nodes.rationale: Owns reactive state (data, total, loading, pagination, sort, filters, search) and auto-refreshes whenever query state changes. Consumes a ListRepository<T> and uses watch() to coalesce synchronous state updates into a single microtask fetch.

nodes.label: Observable<T>
nodes.rationale: Tiny in-house reactive primitive (~80 LOC) replacing RxJS BehaviorSubject. Uses Object.is equality to skip unnecessary notifications. Snapshots subscribers at notify time to safely handle unsubscribe-during-emit.

nodes.label: watch() helper
nodes.rationale: Subscribes to N observables and fires a callback via queueMicrotask when any change, collapsing multiple synchronous updates into one fetch. Replaces the combineLatest + auditTime(0) RxJS pattern.

nodes.label: HttpListRepository<T>
nodes.rationale: Extends ListRepository with HTTP fetching. Validates baseUrl eagerly in constructor. Supports custom responseListMapper for non-canonical API shapes.

nodes.label: FetchHttpClient
nodes.rationale: Default IHttpClient implementation backed by the standard fetch API. Handles JSON serialization, query string building, 204 No Content, array params, and AbortSignal forwarding.

nodes.label: mapTableParams
nodes.rationale: Converts internal pagination/sort/filter/search state into outgoing HTTP query params. Respects configurable queryKeys and paramFormatting strategy.

nodes.label: IRealtimeAdapter<T>
nodes.rationale: Placeholder contract for WebSocket/SSE adapters. Interface-only in core so plugins can be added without churn.

nodes.label: SstTableService<T>
nodes.rationale: Extends TableStore<T> and adds Angular Signal accessors via observableToSignal. Auto-destroys via DestroyRef.onDestroy.

nodes.label: NgHttpClient
nodes.rationale: Angular-specific IHttpClient adapter that wraps Angular's HttpClient and converts observables to promises via firstValueFrom.

nodes.label: SstNgListRepository<T>
nodes.rationale: Extends ListRepository directly (not HttpListRepository) because Angular DI instantiates the parent constructor before subclass getters are bound, so baseUrl must be read lazily via requireBaseUrl().

nodes.label: observableToSignal
nodes.rationale: Bridges IReadonlyObservable<T> to an Angular Signal<T>. Must run inside injection context; auto-cleans via DestroyRef.

nodes.label: SstTableComponent<T>
nodes.rationale: Default styled Angular component with content slots (#headerCell, #bodyCell, #emptyState, #bulkActions). No ng-zorro dependency. Standalone component with signal-based change detection.

nodes.label: useObservable composable (Vue)
nodes.rationale: Wraps IReadonlyObservable<T> in a Vue Ref<T> and auto-cleans on onScopeDispose.

nodes.label: useTableStore composable (Vue)
nodes.rationale: Instantiates a TableStore<T>, exposes Ref<T> views over each observable, and binds action methods. Destroys store on onScopeDispose.

nodes.label: SstTable.vue
nodes.rationale: Default Vue SFC with scoped slots (header-cell, body-cell, empty-state, bulk-actions, pagination). No external UI library. Generic T extends { id: string } to match bulk-selection logic.

nodes.label: useObservable hook (React)
nodes.rationale: Uses useSyncExternalStore for concurrent rendering safety — the canonical React 18 way to subscribe to an external store.

nodes.label: useTableStore hook (React)
nodes.rationale: Uses useRef to create one TableStore<T> per mount. Destroys the store on unmount.

nodes.label: @bridgebyte/sst-core Package
nodes.rationale: Framework-agnostic core providing reactive table state and configurable repositories. Zero runtime dependencies; uses a tiny in-house Observable<T> (~80 LOC) instead of RxJS, preserving portability across Angular, Vue, React, DOM.

nodes.label: mountTable
nodes.rationale: Single public entry point for the DOM variant: mountTable({ target, store, columns }) produces a working HTML table wired reactively to a TableStore<T>.

nodes.label: PaginationStyle ('page' | 'offset')
nodes.rationale: Offset mode emits skip=(page-1)*pageSize instead of page number, enabling backends like DummyJSON without a custom IHttpClient.

nodes.label: searchEndpoint option
nodes.rationale: Routes search requests to a different URL path (e.g. /products/search) instead of adding a param to the base URL. Lives in HttpListRepository.getList because it is URL routing, not param building.

nodes.label: onSave callback (inline editing)
nodes.rationale: Optimistic local update with rollback on rejection. Bridges PrimeVue onCellEditComplete/onRowEditSave to the store without any @bridgebyte/sst-core change.

nodes.label: defineTable factory
nodes.rationale: Returns a typed useTable() composable from a config object. Bridges the Vue composition model to the Angular 'inherit+override' DX. Each useTable() call creates a fresh store auto-disposed via onScopeDispose.

nodes.label: useSstDataTable composable
nodes.rationale: Returns a v-bind-able bag of lazy DataTable props and event handlers, mapping PrimeVue @page/@sort/@filter events onto TableStore methods. PrimeVue is an optional peer dependency.

nodes.label: SstDataTable.vue
nodes.rationale: Thin wrapper that calls useSstDataTable and renders <DataTable v-bind> forwarding $attrs and all slots. Ships zero CSS; theming comes from the host's PrimeVue preset.

nodes.label: resolveLayoutSlot
nodes.rationale: Pure function for mobile-first cascade: finds the active slot by walking breakpoints from the current width downward until a defined slot is found, returning null when the table range owns the viewport.

nodes.label: useBreakpoint composable
nodes.rationale: SSR-safe matchMedia composable: defaults to the largest token before mount / when matchMedia unavailable, switching on the client after first render to avoid hydration mismatch.

nodes.label: tableBreakpoint prop
nodes.rationale: Configures where PrimeVue DataTable takes over from custom layout slots. Default 'lg'. 'none' means never render the table.

nodes.label: BreakpointToken (Tailwind cascade)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind breakpoints (xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl) used as slot names. Mobile-first cascade: a slot applies from its min-width up to the next defined slot or the table breakpoint.

nodes.label: Declarative Backend Conventions Design
nodes.rationale: Declarative options chosen over buildRequest hook or named presets to keep the API simple. Only three axes (pagination, sort direction, search path) — combined-sort and static params are YAGNI.

nodes.label: paginationStyle (offset/page) Config
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Allows adapting offset-based backends without a custom HTTP client; avoids requiring consumers to write boilerplate query mapping

nodes.label: sortStyle (flag/direction) Config
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Adapts asc/desc sort APIs without requiring custom serialization logic in consumers

nodes.label: mapTableParams formatFilter Fix
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Bug fix: formatFilter was declared but ignored, always array-wrapping filter values which broke backends rejecting key[] query arrays

nodes.label: mountTable(options)
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Single-call API chosen to minimize friction for vanilla JS users; returns a handle with destroy/refresh instead of exposing fine-grained internals

nodes.label: sst-dom style.css (CSS custom properties)
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Optional CSS driven entirely by custom properties on .sst-table so consumers can restyle without touching JS; shipped as optional import

nodes.label: Integer-ID Row Constraint Relaxation (ng)
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Integer-keyed backends (e.g. Laravel) no longer need to stringify ids; ids coerced internally for bulk selection so non-breaking

nodes.label: SstTableService<T>
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Injectable TableStore using Angular signals with automatic teardown via DestroyRef; wraps core TableStore for Angular DI compatibility

nodes.label: NgHttpClient
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Adapts Angular's HttpClient to IHttpClient so Angular interceptors and DI work transparently with core SST logic

nodes.label: @bridgebyte/sst-react Package (Planned)
nodes.rationale: React 18+ adapter planned but not yet implemented; references 04-react.md implementation plan

nodes.label: Integer-ID Row Constraint Relaxation (vue)
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Integer-keyed backends no longer need to stringify ids; coerced to strings internally for bulk selection and bulkDelete

nodes.label: defaultMapFilters Export
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Exported so custom mapFilters implementations can compose the default behavior rather than replacing it entirely

nodes.label: defineTable<T>(config)
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Declarative factory that co-locates repository + store config in one object to reduce boilerplate; returns a typed composable per table

nodes.label: useSstDataTable(store, options?)
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Headless composable for consumers who need full DataTable control while keeping store binding; spread onto <DataTable v-bind>

nodes.label: useBreakpoint() Composable
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: SSR-safe matchMedia composable extracted so it can be used standalone outside SstDataTable; ssrDefault prop avoids desktop-to-mobile hydration swap

nodes.label: Responsive Layout Slots (#xs..#2xl) on SstDataTable
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first cascade: each slot covers from its breakpoint up to the next defined slot; tableBreakpoint prop (default lg) controls when the DataTable renders

nodes.label: setPage(n) / setPageSize(n) Store Actions
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Convenience actions to avoid spread boilerplate when updating only page or pageSize; both keep the other half and refetch

nodes.label: @bridgebyte/sst-vue/primevue Subpath
nodes.author: Dinu Iordachi
nodes.rationale: Separate subpath keeps PrimeVue as optional peer dependency so sst-vue base remains PrimeVue-free; typesVersions fallback added for legacy moduleResolution

nodes.label: Verdaccio Local Registry (publish/install workflow)
nodes.rationale: test/* apps are NOT workspace members so npm install goes through Verdaccio — the only way to verify published artifacts (not symlinked sources)

nodes.label: JsonApiHttpClient (test/vue custom client)
nodes.rationale: Works around FetchHttpClient's application/json-only content-type sniff when using JSON:API responses with vnd.api+json content type
